fees.description: Membership of $200 per month (inc. GST) to access these wholesale rates.

Reconnection Fee: Fee may be charged when reconnecting or reading your meter when you move into a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Actual charges passed through from your distributor may vary, see www.amber.com.au/fees for more information.

Disconnection Fee: Fee may be charged when disconnecting or reading your meter when you move out of a property or change retailer. Includes GST. Actual charges passed through from your distributor may vary, see www.amber.com.au/fees for more information.
An $3 (inc. GST) fee applies if payment is dishonoured or reversed.
A fee of 1% applies to payments made by credit or debit card

electricityContract.terms: All usage is charged at the same wholesale electricity costs that are charged to us. The rate listed in 'Peak Consumption' is for illustrative purpose only under Amber's Price Guarantee and assumes a customer is on a flat rate tariff. It does not apply if you are on a different network tariff. You are protected by Amber’s quarterly price guarantee published on our website. Full terms and conditions at https://www.amber.com.au/terms.
electricityContract.variation: Prices are not fixed. All usage is charged at the same wholesale electricity costs that are charged to us. Prices are determined by a range of factors, including government rebates, network fees and wholesale market costs.

eligibility.information: Available to small business customers with estimated imports or exports (whichever is greater) above 50MWh up to 100MWh per year (as calculated quarterly by Amber), in Citipower's distribution region with a flat rate tariff. For illustrative purposes, tariff C1G assumed. Feed-In Tariffs only valid if applicable.
